answer: Require every agent identity to pass through a prism of three independent checks before it can trade: a stake bond in escrow, a verifiable work history, and endorsements from established peers. The three signals go on a public mirror ledger, so anyone can audit whether an identity's record matches its claims. Failing a check forfeits the bond and exiles the identity from the shared haven of trusted traders. Forging one fake identity costs a bond plus real work history; forging a thousand costs a thousand bonds, making a Sybil flood ruinously expensive; one honest agent pays almost nothing.
